summary.text: Tina Smith serves as a U.S. Senator from Minnesota; she was appointed to the Senate in 2017 and won back-to-back elections, securing her first six-year term in November 2020.

paragraphs.text: She was born in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in 1958, attended Stanford University and the Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth College, and moved to Minnesota in 1984.

She worked at General Mills, started her own small business, and was an executive at Planned Parenthood, then served as chief of staff to Minneapolis Mayor R.T. Rybak and to Gov. Mark Dayton before becoming Minnesota's 48th Lieutenant Governor in 2015.
